question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given word.

Bright
solution:
The correct answer is: **Radiant**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Bright"** means full of light, shining, or emitting a lot of light. It can also mean intelligent or cheerful. (चमकदार, तेज)

 
 
• **Example:** The bright sunlight filled the room with warmth.
 
 
 
• **"Radiant"** means shining or glowing brightly, often used to describe something emitting light or heat, or someone looking happy and healthy. (दमकता हुआ)
 
 
• **Example:** She looked radiant in her wedding dress.
 
 
 
• Hence, the most appropriate meaning of the word "Bright" is "Radiant."

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Radiant**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Immense** (विशाल): Extremely large or great in size, scale, or degree.

 
 
• **Example:** The ocean is an immense body of water.
 
 
 
• **Hooked** (आदी): Captivated, fascinated, or addicted to something.
 
 
• **Example:** He is hooked on reading mystery novels.
 
 
 
• **Unlit** (बुझा हुआ): Not lit; lacking light or illumination.
 
 
• **Example:** The room was unlit and filled with shadows.
